data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for controlling screen brightness with application lifecycle reset.
data.what_it_does: Allows getting and setting application and system screen brightness levels. Provides streams to listen for brightness changes and automatically handles resetting brightness based on app lifecycle.
use_when: You need to adjust screen brightness from within a Flutter app.
You want to track system or application brightness changes using streams.
avoid_when: You only need to prevent the screen from sleeping (use wakelock instead).
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and OHOS.
weaknesses: Adjusting system brightness on Android requires adding the WRITE_SETTINGS permission.
data.setup_notes: To adjust system brightness on Android, add the WRITE_SETTINGS permission in your AndroidManifest.xml file.
